[P2] Document the required design note for session validation

Rule 3, “Write a design note before the code,” applies to this new session-validation functionality. The description explains the implementation and compatibility decisions, but still omits the required cause and comparison of approaches, including simplification of existing logic, and does not identify an agreed design note in the linked issues. This leaves the required design review undocumented. Please return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6, and document or explicitly reference a compliant note with maintainer agreement.
